items.title: DNS naming for load-balanced services
items.body: Public services behind our load balancers are published as a CNAME to <virtual-server-name>.edge.orion.example, where <virtual-server-name> is the name of the virtual server in the load balancer. Records pointing at third-party SaaS must belong to a vendor in the vendor register with an active account.
